description: Decrypt an .s3enc file made by the S3eidat File Encrypt website or crypto_file_encrypt, verify every chunk, and write the original file back under its stored (sanitised) name. A wrong password, damage, truncation or reordering is reported and nothing is written. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/file-encrypt/

file.description: The .s3enc file: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

output.description: Where to write the decrypted file: a file path, or a folder ending in "/" (keeps the stored name). Default: the server output folder.

password.description: The password. Normalised to Unicode NFC first, like the website.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

name: crypto_file_decrypt
title: Decrypt a file (.s3enc)
